answer.answer:
The passages do not provide an explicit ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense S-parameters, but they support these key VNA/S-parameter-related capabilities for satellite payload and component testing: component RF measurements; converter / mixer group delay; noise figure; amplifier, filter and antenna measurements; group delay; linearity / gain transfer; NPR; EVM; spurious measurements; and frequency-converter measurements without LO access [37][38][83].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace / Defense-adjacent passages |
|---|---|
| Group delay measurement | Group delay measurements characterize phase distortions in satellite communications transmission paths, and relative group delay is critical for judging distortion at frequency converter or transponder channel band edges [86]. |
| Frequency-converter / mixer group delay without LO access | R&S ZNA is described as measuring group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift / noise [83]. |
| Component-level RF measurements | R&S ZNA is positioned for satellite payload component-level testing, including payload components RF measurements, converter / mixer group delay, noise figure, and amplifier / filter / antenna measurements [37][84]. |
| Linearity and gain transfer characterization | Satellite payload/component characterization includes gain compression, AM/AM, AM/PM, NPR, ACLR, DPD and EVM [38]. |
| Wide frequency coverage | R&S ZNA is listed with key features up to 67 GHz, and R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system [37][63]. |
| Multiport capability | R&S ZNA67EXT variants support 2 or 4 test ports, and R&S ZNB3000 models also include 2-port and 4-port VNA configurations across multiple frequency ranges [62][57]. |
| High dynamic range | R&S ZNB3020 dynamic range is specified, under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, from ≥115 dB at 9 kHz to 300 kHz up to ≥145 dB at 10 MHz to 100 MHz and ≥140 dB at 100 MHz to 24 GHz [70]. |
| Effective system accuracy terms | ZNB3020 and ZNB3032 effective system data list directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking and transmission tracking under defined calibration and temperature conditions [71][75]. |
| Time-domain / TDR analysis | R&S ZNA offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis including eye diagram, while R&S ZNB3000 offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis options [19][16]. |
| Deembedding / fixture removal | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB3000 offer Easy / EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding and smart fixture deembedding options [19][16]. |
| Pulsed / high-speed receiver capability | R&S ZNA includes measurements on pulsed signals and increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz options, while R&S ZNB3000 includes pulsed source measurements and a 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option [19][16]. |

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）

- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。

- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

The passages do not provide an explicit ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense S-parameters, but they support these key VNA/S-parameter-related capabilities for satellite payload and component testing: component RF measurements; converter / mixer group delay; noise figure; amplifier, filter and antenna measurements; group delay; linearity / gain transfer; NPR; EVM; spurious measurements; and frequency-converter measurements without LO access [37][38][83].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace / Defense-adjacent passages |
|---|---|
| Group delay measurement | Group delay measurements characterize phase distortions in satellite communications transmission paths, and relative group delay is critical for judging distortion at frequency converter or transponder channel band edges [86]. |
| Frequency-converter / mixer group delay without LO access | R&S ZNA is described as measuring group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift / noise [83]. |
| Component-level RF measurements | R&S ZNA is positioned for satellite payload component-level testing, including payload components RF measurements, converter / mixer group delay, noise figure, and amplifier / filter / antenna measurements [37][84]. |
| Linearity and gain transfer characterization | Satellite payload/component characterization includes gain compression, AM/AM, AM/PM, NPR, ACLR, DPD and EVM [38]. |
| Wide frequency coverage | R&S ZNA is listed with key features up to 67 GHz, and R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system [37][63]. |
| Multiport capability | R&S ZNA67EXT variants support 2 or 4 test ports, and R&S ZNB3000 models also include 2-port and 4-port VNA configurations across multiple frequency ranges [62][57]. |
| High dynamic range | R&S ZNB3020 dynamic range is specified, under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, from ≥115 dB at 9 kHz to 300 kHz up to ≥145 dB at 10 MHz to 100 MHz and ≥140 dB at 100 MHz to 24 GHz [70]. |
| Effective system accuracy terms | ZNB3020 and ZNB3032 effective system data list directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking and transmission tracking under defined calibration and temperature conditions [71][75]. |
| Time-domain / TDR analysis | R&S ZNA offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis including eye diagram, while R&S ZNB3000 offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis options [19][16]. |
| Deembedding / fixture removal | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB3000 offer Easy / EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding and smart fixture deembedding options [19][16]. |
| Pulsed / high-speed receiver capability | R&S ZNA includes measurements on pulsed signals and increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz options, while R&S ZNB3000 includes pulsed source measurements and a 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option [19][16]. |

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。
- Bandpass filter 會在 band edges 增加更多 group delay。
- 在 satellite communications systems 中，frequency converter 或 transponder channels 的 relative group delay 對判定 each channel band edges 的 distortion amount 很關鍵。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。

- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

The passages do not provide an explicit ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense S-parameters, but they support these key VNA/S-parameter-related capabilities for satellite payload and component testing: component RF measurements; converter / mixer group delay; noise figure; amplifier, filter and antenna measurements; group delay; linearity / gain transfer; NPR; EVM; spurious measurements; and frequency-converter measurements without LO access [37][38][83].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace / Defense-adjacent passages |
|---|---|
| Group delay measurement | Group delay measurements characterize phase distortions in satellite communications transmission paths, and relative group delay is critical for judging distortion at frequency converter or transponder channel band edges [86]. |
| Frequency-converter / mixer group delay without LO access | R&S ZNA is described as measuring group delay of frequency converters without LO access, especially when traditional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift / noise [83]. |
| Component-level RF measurements | R&S ZNA is positioned for satellite payload component-level testing, including payload components RF measurements, converter / mixer group delay, noise figure, and amplifier / filter / antenna measurements [37][84]. |
| Linearity and gain transfer characterization | Satellite payload/component characterization includes gain compression, AM/AM, AM/PM, NPR, ACLR, DPD and EVM [38]. |
| Wide frequency coverage | R&S ZNA is listed with key features up to 67 GHz, and R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz as a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system [37][63]. |
| Multiport capability | R&S ZNA67EXT variants support 2 or 4 test ports, and R&S ZNB3000 models also include 2-port and 4-port VNA configurations across multiple frequency ranges [62][57]. |
| High dynamic range | R&S ZNB3020 dynamic range is specified, under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, from ≥115 dB at 9 kHz to 300 kHz up to ≥145 dB at 10 MHz to 100 MHz and ≥140 dB at 100 MHz to 24 GHz [70]. |
| Effective system accuracy terms | ZNB3020 and ZNB3032 effective system data list directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking and transmission tracking under defined calibration and temperature conditions [71][75]. |
| Time-domain / TDR analysis | R&S ZNA offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis including eye diagram, while R&S ZNB3000 offers time domain analysis and extended time domain analysis options [19][16]. |
| Deembedding / fixture removal | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB3000 offer Easy / EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding and smart fixture deembedding options [19][16]. |
| Pulsed / high-speed receiver capability | R&S ZNA includes measurements on pulsed signals and increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz options, while R&S ZNB3000 includes pulsed source measurements and a 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option [19][16]. |

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。
- Bandpass filter 會在 band edges 增加更多 group delay。
- 在 satellite communications systems 中，frequency converter 或 transponder channels 的 relative group delay 對判定 each channel band edges 的 distortion amount 很關鍵。
